name: tpl-chain-response-3-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Clause R2 uses RespondedExistence(at_exit, holding_box), which only requires that if the agent reaches the exit, it holds the box at some time before or after the exit. The task 'Carry the box to the exit' demands that the box be in the agent's hands at the moment the exit is reached, not merely sometime around it. Therefore the template is wrong; it should be a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) (or an equivalent hard goal that enforces holding_box on the same step as at_exit). Replace the RespondedExistence clause with a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) to correctly capture the requirement.

texts: Reach the exit at some point
If the agent reaches the exit, the box must be held at that moment
Whenever the box falls, the agent must pick it up on the very next step
